'''Rufino Sanchez''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 8th at [[2000 Modesto Enduro]] on 15 July 2000 with EBO Baragwin Retrieval, according to Alfred Dong's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1020">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-18-enduro-7-15-modesto-cad1020/ enduro-7-15-modesto-ca], DeckTech (Alfred "ThaBraHmaBuL" Dong, 18 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-18-enduro-7-15-modesto-cad1020/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
